sourceNote: KFC Deutschland's FAQ links "Nährwert- und Allergeninformationen" to a PDF, https://static.kfc.de/pdf/ALLERGENE.pdf (33 pages: "Zusatzinformationen zu verpackten Produkten" and "zu zubereiteten Produkten", September 2026, and "zu Kwench Produkten", July 2026). The server stalls scripted downloads, so the file was saved from a browser on 30 October 2026 and is recorded with its SHA-256; every row names its page. A prepared product states its portion size ("Nettofüllmenge/Portionsgröße") and per 100 g (per 100 ml for drinks) and per portion: energy in kJ and kcal, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugar, protein and salt. A packaged product states its net quantity and per 100 g only; one stated in grams is that portion, a sauce stated in ml has no stated weight and stays per 100 g. Kwench drinks are stated without ice. Values written "<0,1" are left out. The two columns go through the same rules as the other chains; each row that needed one says so. Left out: extras added to another item (bacon and cheese slices, butter, banana sprinkles).
sha256Note: SHA-256 of the PDF as saved from the browser; every row comes from it.
